notes: SystemLanguageModel.contextSize is @backDeployed(before: macOS 26.4) from macOS 26.0, so it needs no availability check at a macOS 26.0 deployment target. SystemLanguageModel.tokenCount(for:) is available from macOS 26.4 only and needs #available. Both are unavailable on tvOS and watchOS; this macOS case cannot test that part of the claim. Sosumi's tokenCount(for:) page documents only the Instructions overload, with macOS 26.4 availability; the overload that takes transcript entries has no page of its own.
